title: NMRNet · 核磁化学位移预测
question: 能否用统一的深度学习框架，从三维原子环境预测液态与固态 NMR 化学位移，并建立可复用的评测基准？
questionEn: Can one unified deep-learning framework predict liquid- and solid-state NMR chemical shifts from 3D atomic environments and support reproducible benchmarking?
summary: NMRNet 使用 SE(3) Transformer 建模原子环境，并采用预训练 + 微调范式；工作同时整理了覆盖多类化学体系的 NMR benchmark。
summaryEn: NMRNet models atomic environments with an SE(3) Transformer using a pretraining-and-fine-tuning paradigm, together with a benchmark spanning diverse NMR datasets.
meaning: 把 3D 几何、等变建模和真实谱学任务连起来，是“representation → model → spectroscopy”最直接的案例之一。
meaningEn: A direct example connecting 3D geometry, equivariant modeling, and a real spectroscopy task.

title: 电解液通用机器学习势 · uMLP / OP-Elyte
titleEn: Universal ML potential for battery electrolytes
question: 能否构建覆盖广泛电解液化学空间的机器学习势，用更低成本进行长时间尺度分子动力学并计算关键电解液性质？
questionEn: Can a domain-oriented universal ML potential cover broad electrolyte chemical space and enable long-timescale molecular dynamics for key electrolyte properties?
summary: 工作使用随机组合电解液与并行/迭代式数据生成策略构建训练集，以机器学习势驱动 MLMD，并用于密度、溶剂化结构、黏度、电导率等性质分析。
summaryEn: The work builds training data through randomized electrolyte compositions and iterative learning, then uses the ML potential for MLMD studies of density, solvation, viscosity, conductivity and related properties.
meaning: 展示 AI 不只是做一个静态 property predictor，还可以成为高精度模拟的加速器。
meaningEn: Shows that AI can accelerate high-fidelity simulation, not only static property prediction.

title: Cat-KG + LLM · 接力催化路径推荐
question: 如何把分散在大量文献里的催化反应知识结构化，并让模型给出可追溯、可检查的接力催化路径建议？
questionEn: How can scattered catalysis literature be structured so that pathway recommendations remain traceable and inspectable?
summary: LLM 辅助从文献中提取反应数据，构建 Cat-KG；图查询产生候选路径，化学规则负责筛选和排序，LLM 再把结构化结果转成化学家可读的表达。
summaryEn: LLMs assist reaction-data extraction for Cat-KG construction; graph queries produce candidate pathways, chemistry-informed rules rank them, and an LLM renders the structured results for chemists.
meaning: 这是“LLM 不直接拍答案，而是与结构化知识、专家规则结合”的典型科研工作流。
meaningEn: A strong example of combining LLMs with structured knowledge and expert rules rather than asking the LLM to invent the answer directly.

title: NOSE · 分子–受体–气味语义三模态
question: 分子结构、嗅觉受体序列和自然语言气味描述能否进入同一个连续表征空间？
questionEn: Can molecular structure, olfactory-receptor sequences and natural-language odor descriptions be aligned in one representation space?
summary: NOSE 通过三模态正交对比学习对齐分子、受体和语义信息，并在嗅觉感知与零样本检索任务上进行评测。
summaryEn: NOSE aligns molecular, receptor and semantic information through tri-modal orthogonal contrastive learning and evaluates the representation on olfactory perception and zero-shot retrieval tasks.
meaning: 把“multimodal”从一句口号落到具体科学对象：结构、生物受体与人类语言。
meaningEn: Turns multimodality into concrete scientific objects: structure, biological receptors and human language.

title: Uni-XAS · 光谱 ↔ 三维结构双向学习
question: XAS 光谱与局域三维原子结构能否在统一框架里双向建模，而不是把正向预测和反演结构完全拆开？
questionEn: Can XAS spectra and local 3D atomic structures be modeled bidirectionally in one framework rather than as disconnected forward and inverse tasks?
summary: Uni-XAS 将 XAS 与 3D 结构建模为跨模态对齐和条件生成问题，包含光谱–结构检索、光谱预测和条件 3D 结构生成。
summaryEn: Uni-XAS formulates XAS and 3D structure modeling as cross-modal alignment and conditional generation, covering retrieval, spectrum prediction and conditional 3D structure generation.
meaning: 它把 spectroscopy、3D geometry 和 multimodal learning 串在同一案例里。
meaningEn: Connects spectroscopy, 3D geometry and multimodal learning in one case.

title: 先进封装电子电镀 · 配方研发智能体
question: 能否把吸附、扩散、分子设计和 CVS 响应等垂域模型串起来，让电镀添加剂与配方研发从经验试错走向高通量预测与实验迭代？
questionEn: Can domain models for adsorption, diffusion, molecular design and CVS response be orchestrated to shift electroplating R&D from experience-driven trial-and-error toward high-throughput prediction and experimental iteration?
summary: 公开项目介绍显示，联合团队构建了电镀垂域模型体系，并进一步融合通用大模型的任务理解与推理能力，形成面向配方研发的智能体。当前公开证据层级是官方项目成果介绍，而不是在本课程中把它包装成已发表论文。
summaryEn: The official project description reports a suite of domain models for electroplating and an R&D agent built by integrating them with a general model. In this course it is explicitly labeled as an official project result rather than presented as a peer-reviewed paper.
meaning: 这是 Agent 概念真正落到材料配方研发时的例子：Agent 的价值来自专业模型、工具和验证闭环，而不是聊天界面。
meaningEn: Shows what an agent means in formulation R&D: value comes from specialist models, tools and validation loops, not a chat interface.
